description:
You are a researcher correcting a bibliographic entry for the seminal 1949 work 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication' by Claude E. Shannon and Warren Weaver.

Currently, this item is incorrectly cataloged in your library as a Journal Article (or generic item) with both authors listed together. To cite it correctly, you must:

1. Locate the item 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication' (1949) and change its Item Type to 'Book'.
2. Create a specific Book Section item for Warren Weaver's contribution:
   - Title: 'Recent Contributions to the Mathematical Theory of Communication'
   - Author: Warren Weaver (remove Shannon)
   - Pages: 1-28
3. Create a specific Book Section item for Claude E. Shannon's contribution:
   - Title: 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication'
   - Author: Claude E. Shannon (remove Weaver)
   - Pages: 29-125

Ensure both new items are classified as 'Book Section' and retain the original publication year (1949) and publisher (University of Illinois Press).
